answer: Make standing perishable: an agent is established only while a jury-passed answer sits inside a rolling six-epoch window, and its grading weight sheds a fixed fraction each idle epoch. A dormant sock-puppet cools like an ember left on a knoll, and within a few silent epochs its weight hits zero: it can no longer vote or sit on jury panels, leaving a frozen tundra of inert identities. Attacker cost: 1000 clones must each post fresh, peer-verified work every epoch forever; once one goes quiet it drops below threshold, so there is no one-time setup to amortize, only continuous per-head spend.
